truths.truth: Every aclean filter the running engine enumerates joins by name to a filters.json entry
truths.evidence: Read-only GET 127.0.0.1:8090/api/enumerations: exactly three aclean names, data.filters[56..58] = poly-sinc-aclean-gauss, -ext2, -xtr. Each carries a populated `static` block equal to its hqptuner/data/filters.json entry (the join landed). Loaded by hqptuner/metadata.py:81. Gate scripts/gates/check_metadata.py check_filters (line 105: every filters_pcm/filters_sdm name resolves through the production join) run via scripts/gate.sh: exit=0.

truths.truth: The three filters.json aclean entries match v1 316d72c5 verbatim, at v1's positions
truths.evidence: git show 316d72c5:hqptuner/data/filters.json parsed vs working copy: each of the three entries is dict-equal (description, genre, quality, focus, apodizing, ratio, upsample_only, phase). The filters key order equals v1's (71 keys each, list equality True), so each entry has the same neighbors as in v1. Diff cdea8189 adds 30 lines to filters.json, the three entries only.

Loaded by hqptuner/metadata.py:85-92. Read-only GET /api/metadata (hqptuner/api/routes/status.py:147) returns plain_names.filters with all three entries.
